description: Returns the whole history of one indicator for one country or region, up to 1500 values per call, for people signed in to EconDash with full data access; other signed-in accounts get as many values as get_indicator_series. Needs sign-in to EconDash. Without years: the history up to the latest observed value, with the nearest projection in next_projection. With start_year and/or end_year: the values in that range, the latest ones and truncated true when it holds more. Same fields as get_indicator_series. Country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, for example USA, DEU, ARG, or WLD for the world.
country.title: Country

end_year.description: Last calendar year of the series; projections up to this year are included.
end_year.title: End Year

indicator.description: Indicator slug from search_indicators, for example cpi-inflation.
indicator.title: Indicator

start_year.description: First calendar year of the series.
start_year.title: Start Year

name: get_full_series
title: Get full indicator history
